subject: Proposal: DST-safe executive demo windows + blackout plan

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@orchidtech.com>

Cc: Markus Berg <markus.berg@orchidtech.com>, procurement@orchidtech.com

Subject: Exec demo availability + blackout windows (Orchid)

Dylan / team,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up — Markus and I are excited to see Redwood’s inference platform in action. We need to line up an executive-level demo that works across our US, EU and APAC execs. High-level constraints on our side: 

- Markus (EMEA exec): available Mon-Fri 14:00-18:00 CET, not available 20 Nov–26 Nov (travel).
- US exec (Emma): prefers early mornings 07:30-10:30 ET.
- APAC execs: only mornings in SGT (09:00-11:30 SGT) on Tue/Thu.
- Company blackout: Dec 1–5 (internal offsite) — we must avoid that week entirely.
- We have strict no-late-night policy for execs; anything that would place them after 19:30 local is undesirable.

Also: our procurement team needs an initial agenda and rough headcount to start informal approval — copying them above. I attached a timezone_matrix.xlsx with our raw constraints.

Two asks from us: 1) can Redwood propose 3 DST-safe windows (one preferred and two backups) that avoid Dec 1–5 and the travel window above, and 2) can you call out what happens if there’s a DST cutover during rollout (we have EMEA DST change in late March next year).

Thanks,
Emma

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Exec demo availability + blackout windows (Orchid)

Emma — great context, thanks. Attaching a short agenda and a proposed, DST-safe slot matrix. We avoided Dec 1–5 and Markus’s travel window. Proposed options (all times shown in local exec zones):

1) Option A — "Sunrise overlap" (preferred)
   - US: 08:30–09:30 ET
   - EMEA: 13:30–14:30 CET
   - APAC: 20:30–21:30 SGT (we know this pushes late in APAC; only recommended if APAC execs explicitly confirm)

2) Option B — "Workday bridge" (balanced)
   - US: 07:30–08:30 ET
   - EMEA: 12:30–13:30 CET
   - APAC: 19:30–20:30 SGT

3) Option C — "Split session + recording" (no single inconvenient slot)
   - 30-minute exec-focused demo for US+EMEA: 09:00–09:30 ET / 14:00–14:30 CET (recorded)
   - Follow-up APAC deep-dive 11:00–11:45 SGT next business day (video + live Q&A)

Notes on DST: our recommended approach is Option C for the lowest DST risk — split sessions avoid a single fragile cross-zone window and give post-demo flexibility for APAC. If you prefer a single global window, we’ll add a DST fallback policy: for any DST cutover week we automatically offer the recorded session + live carry-forward with local Redwood reps.

Attached: Orchid_MVP-Agenda.pdf (one-pager) and a quick timezone_matrix.xlsx with our conversions.

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether APAC execs can tolerate 20:30 SGT? If procurement needs more detail for headcount/cost, Rafael (cc’d) can provide a draft quote. Kimberly will lead exec coordination on our side.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Dylan — useful options. Quoting your message below for context.

> Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Option C — "Split session + recording" (no single inconvenient slot)
> - 30-minute exec-focused demo for US+EMEA: 09:00–09:30 ET / 14:00–14:30 CET (recorded)
> - Follow-up APAC deep-dive 11:00–11:45 SGT next business day (video + live Q&A)

We like Option C — it respects our executive blackout preferences and reduces DST fragility. A couple of points: 
- APAC execs have a hard stop at 11:45 SGT; 11:00 is fine as long as the session doesn't run long.
- Please avoid proposing anything that lands after 19:30 local for EMEA execs — Markus flagged that as a firm boundary.
- Procurement: we need an estimated headcount (5 execs + 3 technical) and a one-line cost placeholder to move to informal approval. Rafael — can you send a short quote?

Also, on DST: March cutover around Mar 28 is on our radar. We’d prefer Redwood to state explicitly what happens if the scheduled meeting straddles a DST change (e.g., send an auto-notification 7 days prior and offer a recorded + carry-forward session).

If you send invites for the split sessions we’ll confirm internal attendees and finalize.

—Emma
